name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/quartz-post-listing
description: Quartz 5 component: the site's posts, newest first, filtered to the tag on a tag page, each with its tags as badges, each holding its tag's bubble: the icon, rimmed in the tag's colour, from the quartz-tags engine. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Every entry has its type declarations beside it, which build.mjs emits: Quartz's generated plugin index skips a package without dist/index.d.ts, and a TypeScript site imports the types from them. ./package.json is how Quartz reads the manifest (import.meta.resolve).
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here: the component's vnodes must be the host's Preact's. The types are imported for types only.
//dependencies: @chaoticgoodcomputing/icons draws each tag's icon while the site builds, with Iconify's packages, which can't all be inlined (svgo, under @iconify/tools, reads its data files at run time). So they stay out of dist/ and install here, at exactly the library's versions, which build.mjs checks (libs/icons/docs/adr/0001). MDI is one of them, pinned exactly, and by the workspace's lock: nothing is fetched.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild bundles dist/, inlining our libraries and reading-time, and @chaoticgoodcomputing/css-check checks the stylesheet against ADR-0003 before it ships, and @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations writes the .d.ts beside each entry (build.mjs). The libraries are `workspace:*` specs, which `pnpm publish` rewrites to the published version (ADR-0005).
